finding.headline: "The Public-Breastfeeding-Shy Mama"
finding.problem: "Every time he cries in public I panic. Do I go to the loo? A corner? People stare. I've skipped outings for weeks because feeding him feels like a crime."
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)
finding.person: A 28-yr-old diaspora mum in Manchester, terrified to nurse in church/Market Square/on the bus; uses a toilet or stays home; feels "exposed" and "judged."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Feed Him Anywhere, Mama: The Confident Public-Breastfeeding & Cover-Free Toolkit (church, market, bus, diaspora)."". Verdict: PASSES (21/25)..
